fact: 美国国家经济研究局（NBER）认定1937—1938年衰退从1937年5月持续至1938年6月；实际GDP下降约10%，失业率回升至约20%，工业生产下降32%。

sources.quote: According to the National Bureau of Economic Research, the 1937 contraction, which lasted from May 1937 until June 1938……Real GDP fell 10 percent. Unemployment, which had declined considerably after 1933, hit 20 percent. Finally, industrial production fell 32 percent.

fact: 1937年2月5日，罗斯福向国会提交联邦司法重组方案，提议为每位年过70岁6个月仍未退休的在任大法官增派一名新法官（当时符合条件者6人，可使最高法院由9人扩至15人）；该'法院填塞计划'遭国会与公众反对，最终被参议院否决。

fact: 1936年12月30日至1937年2月11日，密歇根州弗林特通用汽车费舍尔车身工厂工人举行44天静坐罢工，迫使通用汽车承认联合汽车工人工会（UAW）；数周后美国钢铁公司未经罢工即接受CIO工会化。

sources.title: The 44-day sit-down strike in Flint, Michigan forced General Motors to recognize the United Auto Workers（UH Digital History）
sources.quote: The 44-day sit-down strike in Flint, Michigan forced General Motors to recognize the United Auto Workers. A few weeks later, U.S. Steel accepted unionization without a strike.

fact: 1937年5月30日（阵亡将士纪念日），在'小钢铁罢工'期间，一群工会成员前往共和钢铁公司工厂门口设立纠察线时遭芝加哥警察开枪，10人被打死或重伤致死、多人受伤。

sources.title: The Memorial Day Massacre and American Labor（Oxford Research Encyclopedia of American History）
sources.quote: On the afternoon of May 30, 1937, the Chicago Police killed or mortally wounded ten men who were among a large group of unionists attempting to picket a mill operated by the Republic Steel Corporation.

fact: 1937—1938年衰退中，美国失业率从1937年5月的14.3%跳升至1938年6月的约19—20%；工业生产自1937年8月至1938年3月下跌逾30%，耐用消费品生产下跌更快。

sources.title: Recession of 1937-38（Federal Reserve History）
sources.quote: Unemployment, which had declined considerably after 1933, hit 20 percent. Finally, industrial production fell 32 percent (Bordo and Haubrich 2012).

sources.title: 1937 - A Crucial Turning Point in the Shadow of the Great Depression
sources.quote: Unemployment surged again, rising from 14.3% in 1937 to nearly 19% by 1938. Industrial production dropped by more than 30% between August 1937 and March 1938.

fact: 1937—1938年衰退中工业生产下降约32%、耐用消费品跌幅更快，反映美国重工业与汽车产业在新政财政紧缩与工会冲突叠加下的剧烈波动；衰退主因之一是1936—1937年美联储两次提高商业银行法定准备金率。

fact: 到1937年底，产业工会联合会（CIO）已在汽车、玻璃、无线电、橡胶、钢铁等产业建立工会，会员达370万，超过美国劳工联合会（AFL）的340万。

sources.title: Digital History（University of Houston）
sources.quote: The CIO formed unions in the auto, glass, radio, rubber, and steel industries, and by the end of 1937, it had more members than the American Federation of Labor (AFL)--3.7 million CIO members against 3.4 million AFL members.

fact: 1937年1月起，美国《社会保障法》开始对雇员与雇主分别按年薪3000美元以下部分的1%征收工资税（合计2%），这是工薪阶层工资单上第一次出现联邦社保扣款；首批社会保障福利1942年1月才开始支付。

sources.title: Social Security: A Program and Policy History（美国社会保障总署 SSA）
sources.quote: The original Social Security Act assessed—on both employees and employers—a 1 percent payroll tax on the first $3,000 of annual earnings, starting in 1937.
